title: Understanding the Model
text: Wesley is using a linear model with two features: $${x_{i1}}^3$$ and $$\ln\left(x_{i2}\right)$$. He has $$30$$ unique data points. What does this imply about the model's ability to find a unique solution?

title: Adding a New Feature
text: If Wesley adds $${x_{i1}}^6$$ as a new feature, how does this affect the model? Consider the relationship between the new feature and the existing feature $${x_{i1}}^3$$.

title: Linear Dependence
text: Think about the relationship between $${x_{i1}}^3$$ and $${x_{i1}}^6$$. Are they linearly independent? What does this mean for the model's ability to find a unique solution?

title: Checking for Linear Independence
text: Determine if $${x_{i1}}^3$$ and $${x_{i1}}^6$$ are linearly independent. If they are not, what does this imply about the model's ability to find a unique solution?
